sloka: अहमेको ऽपि पर्याप्तः सराक्षसगणां पुरीम् ।तां लङ्कां तपसा हन्तुं रावणं च महाबलम् ।। ५.५९.७ ।।।।
transliteration: ahameko 'pi paryāptaḥ sarākṣasagaṇāṁ purīm ।tāṁ laṅkāṁ tapasā hantuṁ rāvaṇaṁ ca mahābalam ।। 5.59.7 ।।।।

translations.english: I alone am enough to destroy by force the city of Lanka with its demon hordes and the mighty Ravana.
